about: project-datum 6679: every shipped feature is reachable and described through MCP. One row per feature: `say` is text its tool's description or input schema must contain (tools/list, one source with the docs), `calls` are real tools/call requests and what their answers must carry. Run by mcp::tools::exposure (cargo test -p btwserve, the real Tools) and by crates/btwserve/deploy/mcp-exposure.py (live, MCP over HTTPS, in every beatscript.app deploy script). expect: [pointer, op, value]: = equal, has present and not null, ~ the value (as JSON text) contains, !~ it does not. save: {name: pointer} keeps a value for ${name} in later args. auth: needs a signed-in caller (and for eval, load and queue a tab); stores: stores a program on the site; live, both run only with a token (and a call whose ${name} was not saved is skipped). Every page in docs/btw/*.md is a row's `docs` or a `not_features` entry with its reason: a new page fails the test until it has one.

not_features.ext-render.md: the offline render's control lines: render's own description says what it plays
not_features.ext-scale.md: the language (scale degrees, Roman numerals): check compiles it
not_features.ext-shape.md: the language (shapes, lfo): check compiles it

not_features.ext-timing.md: the language (sub-bar timing): check compiles it
not_features.showcase.md: one example track, not a feature
